reply.text:
Yes, 20 minutes is a real session, and on a day like this it counts. Keep it simple: a warm-up of a few minutes, then one or two of your main lifts at a working weight you know well, stopping a couple of reps short of grinding. Leave the ego at the door and head home feeling you did something.

If you tell me what you have planned for tonight, I can check your program and what you have been doing lately so we pick the right 20 minutes.
